name: Henry Wheeler
summary: Henry Wheeler rescued the dropped telescope after Curtis Whateley's collapse and used it to watch the three Arkham scholars chant their incantation against the horror atop Sentinel Hill.
description: After Curtis Whateley dropped the telescope in terror, only Henry Wheeler thought to rescue it and wipe it clean of mud. Trembling, he turned it on the mountain, whispering 'I guess he's sayin' the spell' as he watched a figure raising its hands rhythmically, and saw through the glass that the men from Arkham were all raising their arms in the incantation. He later strained his eye at the telescope but saw only the three grotesquely silhouetted human figures moving their arms furiously as the incantation drew to its culmination.
